actions.text: All chats in this flow start by asking the customer for their full name or Account ID using [Pull up Account].  This will pull up their account in the background with the right information related to this user.
To confirm that their purchase is valid with [Validate Purchase]:
subtext: Username - occasionally, the customer may not remember their username.  In this case, use the Recover Username subflow in the Account Access flow
Email Address
Order ID - last item, to be consistent with verify identity

actions.text: Refund method in [Record Reason] - valid options are
subtext: Gift card - they want a prepaid gift card, also ask for their address so you know where to mail it.  Enter this value in the next step.
Add value - to add value to their account.
Paper check - also ask for their address so you know where to mail the check.  Enter this address in the next step.
Credit card - direct refund to their credit card, assume a credit card is already on file.  To find it, you will need the account ID, which is entered in the next step.

actions.text: Add in additional information using [Enter Details]
subtext: If the customer chose gift card or paper check then enter the full address
If the customer chose add value or credit card then enter the account ID

actions.text: Dollar amount - enter this value into the details form (without the dollar sign)
subtext: Then click [Offer Refund]
If the customer does not know, the default amount is $50

instructions: Start by asking for the refund reason.  Then, to complete the refund, perform the following actions
As always, wrap up by nicely asking if the customer needs any further assistance.
